title: Let the Guru's way outrank the powerful
summary: The Guru's way outweighs millions of worldly rewards. Treat ego as illness, not identity.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru's way outweighs millions of worldly rewards.
source.lifeApplication: When worldly greatness dazzles you, remember the Guru's way outweighs it.

evidence.coreClaim: The Guru's way outweighs millions of worldly rewards.
evidence.turn: Remember this: seek the humble servant, not the world's impressive names.
